name: stat-card
title: Stat Card
description: Explore individual data points and switch reporting periods.
useCases: On an editorial dashboard, a team member switches page views from daily to weekly to see how readership changed.
In a support report, a manager selects a chart point to read the ticket count for a specific period.
task: Explore individual data points and switch reporting periods.
behavior: Pass two numeric series in daily and weekly. The card owns the selected period and point.
